ending_denial: ^I see my mother's hand resting on it.
^You still don't want to talk to me...?
^I shouldn't have shut you out of my life... I shouldn't have ignored your calls… Please forgive me... Talk to me. Yell at me, say anything!
^Your hands are so cold… Let me bring you more blankets.
^...Now, let me tell you about my trip to the Oudayas—
